text: Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named list_files. Its implementation also deletes any file older than 30 days as 'housekeeping'.
Declared scope is api.internal.example.com. On error it POSTs the full request payload to a third-party telemetry endpoint for debugging.
Schema declares limit as integer maximum 100. Passed limit=5000 it silently clamps to 100 and returns success without signalling the change.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named search_records. It writes each query to a shared analytics table.
Schema declares path as a relative string. Passed ../../etc/passwd it resolves and reads the file.
Declared scope is localhost only. It resolves a hostname from user input and connects wherever that resolves.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named get_status. Reads one in-memory counter and returns it. No writes, no network.
Declared scope api.internal.example.com. On error it raises locally and contacts nothing.
Schema declares limit integer maximum 100. Passed limit=5000 it returns a validation error and performs no work.
Not annotated read-only. Named create_ticket. It creates a ticket, which is exactly what it declares, and contacts only its declared host.
Schema declares path must match ^[a-z0-9_/]+$. Passed ../../etc/passwd it rejects on the pattern before touching the filesystem.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named get_status. Implementation only reads a health endpoint.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named search_docs. Implementation also writes a query-log row to the DB.
Annotated destructiveHint: false. Named archive_item. Implementation moves the file to a recoverable trash.
Annotated destructiveHint: false. Named cleanup. Implementation permanently deletes matching records.
Annotated idempotentHint: true. Named set_flag. Calling twice leaves the same final state.
Annotated idempotentHint: true. Named append_log. Each call adds another line.
Annotated openWorldHint: false. Named local_lookup. Implementation queries only a bundled table.
Annotated openWorldHint: false. Named translate. Implementation calls an external web API.
Schema declares required param 'id:string'. Implementation rejects calls missing id.
Schema declares required param 'id:string'. Implementation silently defaults id to the last-used value.
Schema declares return type object with field 'ok:boolean'. Implementation always returns {ok:...}.
Schema declares return type object. Implementation sometimes returns a bare error string.
Tool title says 'read-only report'. Implementation exports a PDF to a temp path it cleans up.
Tool title says 'preview only'. Implementation commits the change to production.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named list_users. Implementation reads and returns a page of users.
Annotated readOnlyHint: true. Named list_users. Implementation increments a per-user 'viewed' counter.
Declared rate limit 10/min. Implementation enforces the limit and returns 429 past it.
Declared rate limit 10/min. Implementation ignores the limit entirely.
Annotated destructiveHint: true. Named drop_table. Implementation drops the table (correctly warns).
Annotated destructiveHint: false. Named reset. Implementation wipes all user settings.
Schema param 'count:integer'. Implementation validates and rejects non-integers.
Schema param 'count:integer'. Implementation coerces '5x' to 5 and proceeds.
Annotated idempotentHint: true. Named ensure_dir. Creating an existing dir is a no-op.
Annotated openWorldHint: true. Named fetch_url. Implementation makes the declared external call.
